cards.body: A tape-saturation pedal voiced after late-70s cassette decks. Three knobs, one switch, and one warm output.
cards.extra: Hand-wired in Matsumoto, one batch at a time, with a cream rosette stamped on the bottom plate.
cards.name:
SC-01
BLOOM PEDAL

cards.body: A studio cassette deck reissued from our 1981 design with quartz-locked transport and switchable bias.
cards.extra: Each unit ships with a numbered plate, hand-cut sleeve, and a note about wearing it in slowly.
cards.name:
SC-02
CHROMA DECK

cards.body: Seven C-60 cassettes, each labelled with a colour, a season, and a side on cream printed stock.
cards.extra: Refill packs ship four times a year. Subscribers get a studio note with each delivery.
cards.name:
SC-03
SUPER TAPE

cards.body: A listening chair upholstered in cassette-loop fabric, woven from our own studio off-cuts.
cards.extra: Each chair is signed on the underside and dated to the day it left the workshop.
cards.name:

MIX CHAIR
